_comment: Copy to config/config.json and fill in. config.json is gitignored.

channel._comment: Either works. 'id' (UC...) skips a lookup call. The denominator of the whole 0-100 scale is this channel's median.

_competitor_comment: Reuse COMPETITOR_CHANNEL_IDS from the Viral Content System. Used for 'did any video beat its own channel median' (Mode B check 2). Leave empty and the tool resolves competitor channels live from search results instead.

median._comment: exclude_younger_than_days: uploads under 30 days have not finished accumulating views, so they are excluded from the median but still reported as reference points. min_duration_seconds filters Shorts out of the median - a channel that posts Shorts otherwise has a meaningless median.

saturation._comment: Hard-gate thresholds from the build brief. Change these only with a reason - they are what makes the tool able to say DON'T FILM. own_recent_video_days drives the cannibalisation gate: your own video on the topic younger than this caps the score.

execution._comment: What Krystian can realistically build and what he already pays for. Mode B check 3 (executability) reads this.

notion._comment: write_back=false keeps the Checker read-only: verdicts go to chat only. Set true to allow writing the verdict onto the backlog row. The independence rule in the brief applies either way.
